headings.text: What happens between apply and offer
Four promises we make to every applicant

sections: What happens between apply and offer
Four promises we make to every applicant
textBlocks: Most recruiting is a black box. TaaSFlow shows you exactly where you stand — from the day you apply to the final decision.
Step 01Apply in minutesUpload your CV, answer a few role-specific questions, and confirm consent. You receive an application reference immediately.Reference issued
Upload your CV, answer a few role-specific questions, and confirm consent. You receive an application reference immediately.
Step 02Information reviewedYour CV is parsed and matched against the role. Every match is backed by evidence — no black boxes, no keyword tricks.Evidence captured
Your CV is parsed and matched against the role. Every match is backed by evidence — no black boxes, no keyword tricks.
Step 03Under considerationA recruiter reviews the evidence and writes a fit narrative. Strong candidates are ranked and delivered to the hiring team.Fit narrative added
A recruiter reviews the evidence and writes a fit narrative. Strong candidates are ranked and delivered to the hiring team.
Step 04ShortlistedYou are on the client's shortlist. We reach out with next steps, expectations, and prep material.Shortlist confirmed
You are on the client's shortlist. We reach out with next steps, expectations, and prep material.
Step 05Interview requestedThe client requests an interview. You see the format, the interviewers, and what they are looking for.Interview scheduled
The client requests an interview. You see the format, the interviewers, and what they are looking for.
Step 06DecisionOffer, further round, or a clear no with reasons. Every outcome is recorded in your candidate workspace.Outcome delivered
Offer, further round, or a clear no with reasons. Every outcome is recorded in your candidate workspace.
Real-time updates in your workspace — no wondering where you stand.
If it's a no, you'll know why. No ghosting, no template rejections.
Withdraw consent or delete your profile at any time.
Talk to your recruiter without long email chains.
Browse open positions or create a candidate profile so we can match you as new roles open.
A live recruiting workspace with ranked, evidence-backed candidate delivery.

links.text: New: transparent role-specific scoring — see how it works.
